draftRevision.name: Riddle-Q
draftRevision.description: Solve  riddles with color clues in Riddle Quest, test yourself and others with this addictive word game.

latestRejection.rejectionReason:
Loads in under 10 seconds: Finding a player for PVP took a really, really long time.

Experience is intuitive, coherent, and complete: Blocker: The $4.99 subscription? What do I get? It has zero description. This is selling a product that the user doesn't understand the benefits of.

Other Notes: 
- The PVP button doesn't match the style of the rest of the game. 
- Your chest reward opening shouldn't be scrollable. 
- Directing players to coins in the shop before they have played a level seems out of order. 
- The level pop ups between stages are making things feel cluttered and over explained. 
- In this same "you won" popup, why do I need to tap the chest to collect my coins? It already told me I get +195 coins so just grant them and don't grey out the next button. This is just adding an extra unnecessary tap. Also next could be a lot bigger - this is a key cta to keep me in the game for multiple rounds.
- Something feels off about the design of the Level Up popup.. level 2 is not centered and very small. Why is the sparkle icon being shown twice? 
- Coin awards feel off. I got +25 coins for completing my fourth riddle but +195 coins for completing my first? that's a huge difference
- Register/Login do the same thing, so I'd combine the buttons (i.e. label can say "Register / Login")

Other notes: Hi Craig, we have some polishing feedback and 2 blockers for you before this gets approved. Please resubmit once you have addressed the notes!
